arrival.text: A ladder? It looks like there used to be a cabin on top. I'll see what it looked like before.

scan.text: I'm the lower part of Eagle, the Apollo 11 lunar module.
In 1969, I brought Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin to the Moon's surface. They were the first humans to walk here.
They climbed down this ladder, collected samples, and set up instruments on the ground.
When it was time to leave, the cabin lifted off and carried them back into lunar orbit, where Michael Collins was waiting.
I stayed behind. I was the platform for that liftoff.
All three astronauts returned safely to Earth.

wrap_up.text: I'll save that picture. There's still another place to visit.

reaction.text: They climbed down that very ladder… What a thing to see.
